title: Charitable and Religious Trusts Amendment Act 1987

sections.shortTitle: Charitable and Religious Trusts Amendment Act 1987
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XII OF 1987
CHARITABLE AND
RELIGIOUS TRUSTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1987
ACT XII OF 1987
An Act further to amend the Charitable and Religious Trusts Act, 1920
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I ]
16th November, 1987]
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Charitable and Religious Trusts Act, 1920 (XIV of 1920), for the
purpose hereinafter appearing;
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Charitable and Religious Trusts (Amendment) Act, 1987.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Charitable and Religious Trusts Amendment Act 1987
sections.description:
Substitution of section 12, Act XIV of 1920

ACT XII OF 1987
CHARITABLE AND
RELIGIOUS TRUSTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1987
ACT XII OF 1987
An Act further to amend the Charitable and Religious Trusts Act, 1920
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I ]
16th November, 1987]
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Charitable and Religious Trusts Act, 1920 (XIV of 1920), for the
purpose hereinafter appearing;
2. Substitution of section 12, Act XIV of 1920.----In the Charitable and Religious
Trusts Act, 1920 (XIV of 1920), for section 12 the following shall be substituted,
namely:--
"12.-- Appeal.--Any person
aggrieved by an order passed , or direction given under this Act, may, within
ninety days of the date of such order or, direction prefer an appeal to the
High Court."
